description: Use the Epi Info 7 Visual Dashboard to analyze the NHANES dataset. You need to: 1) Load the 'NhanesExam.prj' project (Form: BPStudy). 2) Create a new variable 'AgeGroup' by recoding the 'RIDAGEYR' variable into three categories: 'Young Adult' (0-39), 'Middle Aged' (40-59), and 'Older Adult' (60-120). 3) Generate a Means table showing the Mean Systolic Blood Pressure ('BPXSY1') stratified by Gender ('RIAGENDR') and your new 'AgeGroup' variable. 4) Export the resulting Means table to an Excel file named 'BP_Analysis_Results.xlsx' in the Documents folder. 5) Save the Dashboard canvas as 'BP_Project.canvas7'.
